welcome.en: Welcome to our school — we are very happy to see you.
welcome.cn: 欢迎来我们学校——见到你我们非常开心。

come in.en: Come in and sit down by the warm fire.
come in.cn: 进来吧，坐到暖暖的炉火旁。

house.en: Their house is at the end of the street.
house.cn: 他们的房子在街道的尽头。

living room.en: The TV is in the living room.
We watch movies together in the living room every Saturday.
living room.cn: 我们每周六在客厅一起看电影。

kitchen.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
The kitchen smells nice when Mum is baking bread.
kitchen.cn: 妈妈烤面包时，厨房闻起来香喷喷的。

bedroom.en: I keep my bedroom tidy with all the toys on the shelf.
bedroom.cn: 我把卧室收拾整齐，所有玩具都放在架子上。

sofa.en: The cat is sleeping happily on the sofa.
sofa.cn: 猫咪正在沙发上开心地睡觉。

beautiful.en: The garden is full of beautiful flowers in spring.
beautiful.cn: 春天花园里开满了美丽的花。
